'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jarad Konsker LS Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jarad Konsker]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
